cloud sleeve and no bands. rigSide flips the thigh strap, the holster, the

image-right (the rig side), a plane tilt of 0.29 about z through y=1.062
at the centre; the band measures 33-35 mm tall on body_0, between y=1.070
Slung strap: clay_5 shows it crossing the back diagonally about 25 mm
under the belt on the rig hip and dropping to y=0.90 on the other side --
tilt 0.50 through y=1.004. Both drop straps hang off it.
Thigh strap at y=0.855 (body_0 shows the band between 0.845 and 0.875).
Arm bands, measured on clay_2/body_2 at 9x and confirmed on body_0: the
upper band spans 1.250-1.283 and the lower 1.213-1.247, so 32 mm wide at
centres 1.266 and 1.230. The base spec's lower band at 1.196 is 34 mm too
low -- that height is the top hem of the sleeve on that arm, not a band.
hipR from the base spec is unused: the loop radius is torsoHalfWidth(y)
plus hipPadX/hipPadZ, then pushed out until it clears the trousers and the
hip wrap, capped by hipMaxPush. The thigh strap and the arm bands are
fitted to the dressed limb the same way rather than to a spec radius.
